name: A Jonathon
description: Historical recipe from Canadian Farm Cook Book (1911). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Grease a deep pie plate with lard or preferably butter
cut apples in small pieces, not thin slices, and spread over the bottom of plate
make a batter of following: 1 cup cream, 1 egg, 1 cup flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder, a pinch of salt
pour this over the apple and bake in a moderate oven till nicely browned
Serve with a dressing after the Jonathon has been turned upside down on a plate

source.originalInstructions:
1. Grease a deep pie plate with lard or preferably butter
2. cut apples in small pieces, not thin slices, and spread over the bottom of plate
3. make a batter of following: 1 cup cream, 1 egg, 1 cup flour, 1 teaspoon baking powder, a pinch of salt
4. pour this over the apple and bake in a moderate oven till nicely browned
5. Serve with a dressing after the Jonathon has been turned upside down on a plate
